$ deploy --help
Usage: deploy [global options] <command> [options]

Deploy the service.

Commands:
  plan      Print the changes of a deployment.
  apply     Apply the changes of a deployment.
  rollback  Roll back to an earlier release.

Global options:
      --flag-debug  Print the value and the source of each option before the command runs.  env DEPLOY_FLAG_DEBUG
  -h, --help        Show the help.
  -v, --verbose     Print each step.                                                        env DEPLOY_VERBOSE, key verbose
[exit 0]

$ deploy plan --env prod
plan: 2 changes
[exit 0]

$ deploy -v apply -e prod -y
apply: target prod in eu-west-1
apply: 2 changes applied
[exit 0]

$ deploy apply -e prod -y --verbose
apply: target prod in eu-west-1
apply: 2 changes applied
[exit 0]

$ deploy apply -e prod
deploy: main: apply changes prod only with --yes
[exit 1]

$ deploy rollback -e dev --region us-east-1 41
rollback: release 41 restored
[exit 0]

$ deploy plan
deploy: plan: missing --env
[exit 2]

$ deploy plan --env staging
deploy: plan: invalid --env "staging" from flag --env: want dev or prod
[exit 2]

$ deploy aply -e dev
deploy: unknown command "aply" (did you mean apply?)
[exit 2]

$ deploy rollback --help
Usage: deploy rollback [options] RELEASE

Roll back to an earlier release.

Arguments:
      RELEASE  Release to roll back to.

Options:
  -e, --env dev|prod   Environment to act on.      required, env DEPLOY_ROLLBACK_ENV, key rollback.env
      --region string  Region of the environment.  default "eu-west-1", env DEPLOY_ROLLBACK_REGION, key rollback.region

Global options:
      --flag-debug  Print the value and the source of each option before the command runs.  env DEPLOY_FLAG_DEBUG
  -h, --help        Show the help.
  -v, --verbose     Print each step.                                                        env DEPLOY_VERBOSE, key verbose
[exit 0]

$ deploy plan -e dev >/dev/full
deploy: main: write the result of plan: transcript: no space left on device
[exit 1]
